description: Symmetrising-trace Schur elements s_λ(q) for type-A Iwahori-Hecke H_n(q) via Chlouveraki HDR Theorem 4.3 at l = 1.  These are NOT the Markov-trace block weights y_λ; see this script's docstring for why our generic Markov trace (z = 1/(q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2})) does not match any Wenzl SU_q(N) specialisation, and therefore has no closed-form product-over-cells formula.
